rules.title: A Rust module says why it exists
rules.text: Every module opens with a `//!` that says why it exists rather than what its functions are called: the file a reader opens first should tell them whether they are in the right place, and the reason it is separate from its neighbours.

judgement.question: Does this module say why it exists — the decision, the invariant, the reason it is its own file — rather than only what it contains?

criteria.true: there is no module documentation, or it lists contents without saying why the module exists
criteria.false: the header states the reason the module is separate and what it is for
